status: DEV test candidate; factors are Koa's landmark estimates, not owner-approved sizes
method: Manual landmarks on each state's representative frame. Eye metrics: working eye to nose tip, eye to missing-eye socket (or eye to eye). Ear metrics (Hatt 2026-11-07: ear size is an indicator too, especially for angles): near pinna height (apex to base midpoint) and base width, plus ear-apex spacing on front views. All in screen px at the small size vs sit/000 (eye-nose 18.4, eye-socket 26.2, pinna height 21.4, pinna base 24, apex spacing 79.4). Head ratio r = mean of the available eye and ear ratios; factor = 1/r. Pitched or turned heads shorten eye-to-nose, so the ears carry those views. Uncertainty about +-10% (fluffy ear bases are soft). Whole-sprite uniform scale only; no pixels change.
